records: SBI VC Trade's network-support matrix applies to VCTRADE only. It does not establish network support across all SBI Group affiliates, Circle Mint, Ripple services or third-party venues. The matrix confirms native XRP on XRPL, USDC and RLUSD on Ethereum, and no JPYSC deposit/withdrawal support. It does not disclose internal stablecoin/XRP trading pairs, customer balances, executed conversion volume, liquidity depth or price impact. Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD are deployed on XRPL elsewhere; this finding is a venue-specific route gap, not a global lack of XRPL stablecoin liquidity.
